scope.office: DLA purchasing office identified by action documents; individual decision roles not established
scope.period: Initial cohort: seven historical actions plus current parent and child; expanding requires a declared universe and coverage

finding_classes.meaning: A distributor's sales price exceeds its acquisition cost; services, costs, risk and competition may explain the difference.
finding_classes.required: Documented acquisition cost plus relevant cost/service and sale terms if making a margin claim.
finding_classes.not_implied: A markup is neither automatically excessive nor a buyer kickback.

finding_classes.meaning: A feasible, equivalent, contemporaneous lower-cost option was reasonably available and not selected, with acquisition rationale evaluated.
finding_classes.required: Qualified comparator, actual availability, selection terms and decision rationale.
finding_classes.not_implied: A cheaper catalog entry alone does not prove an avoidable overpayment or intent.

finding_classes.meaning: A reproducible price difference remains after declared comparability controls and plausible alternatives are tested.
finding_classes.required: Qualified benchmark and uncertainty range, source-level coverage and independent challenge.
finding_classes.not_implied: It is a request for further explanation, not established loss or corruption.

finding_classes.meaning: A documented procurement decision is linked to evidence of improper influence or benefit, with provenance and ordinary alternatives reviewed.
finding_classes.required: Role/timing evidence, actual communication/benefit evidence and nexus to the procurement.
finding_classes.not_implied: A screening analyst does not turn the indicator into a legal finding.

finding_classes.meaning: A competent official finding, admitted facts or adjudicated record establishes the conduct, with legal status dated.
finding_classes.required: Exact authoritative source and conduct/status/date; distinguish allegations, pleas, settlement and findings.
finding_classes.not_implied: Neither price premium nor commercial identity establishes this class.

normalization_rules: Require documented pack and price units. Dividing box price by a claimed per-piece display can check arithmetic but cannot prove pack count.
Keep item price and government-paid freight distinct, then compare like landed-cost bases. FOB origin does not mean free shipping.
Use quantities actually ordered/invoiced/paid for the chosen basis; an annual estimate, ceiling or cancelled balance is not volume purchased.
Require actual revision/grade/thread/finish/traceability equivalence or a documented technical adjustment; do not use ASME B18.24 alone as a complete product specification.
Preserve the source's monetary precision and round only at declared reporting stages; do not select a tier whose minimum order exceeds feasible demand without accounting for all packs purchased.
Do not infer dated availability from today's stock, or a historical comparable from a current page. Preserve quote validity and delivery capacity.

Maintain business identity and beneficial ownership as different relations. A current CAGE/UEI match, self-parent record, shared upstream manufacturer or punctuation alias does not prove historical ownership or bid coordination.
Do not merge awards, invoice lines and cash disbursements; use unique parent/order/modification/CLIN keys and deduplicate cumulative obligations.

tests.name: Exact technical and commercial qualification
tests.test: For every hard-required field compare source-supported values. Unknown is unresolved, explicit conflict is rejected. A technical difference requires a documented adjustment or separate non-comparable cohort.
tests.output: qualified / unresolved / rejected, with field-level reasons
tests.current_status: blocked; complete primary NSN product specification and compliant independent quote missing

tests.name: Amount-weighted premium
tests.test: For a single declared amount basis, compute E=sum(q*(p-b)), B=sum(q*b), A=sum(q*p); weighted_markup=E/B and excess_share_of_gross=E/A. Require B>0, A>0, finite numbers and common currency.
tests.output: signed excess, positive-only difference separately, baseline-weighted percentage, amount coverage and uncertainty interval
tests.guard: Do not average percentages equally or drop negative differences; no mixed ordered/invoiced/paid rows.

tests.name: Repeated 12 percent hypothesis
tests.test: Before reading outcomes, declare 0.12 as a hypothesis, tolerance (for example 0.01), minimum independent solicitations/periods and complete eligible universe. Count rows and baseline-weighted amount within the band, report all residuals and benchmark sensitivity. Split exploratory and held-out periods; do not round values into a 12 percent pattern.
tests.output: observed repetition and coverage, not a kickback probability
tests.guard: Thresholds are analyst-selected screening settings, not official fraud cutoffs. Multiple lines under one solicitation are not independent repetitions. Seven incomplete history rows cannot establish this test.

tests.name: Mix, quantity and time control
tests.test: Compare within the same item/specification and feasible quantity tier. Construct a fixed-basket comparison using baseline quantities. Match time windows or document an item-relevant dated adjustment; run no-adjustment and bounded-adjustment sensitivity. Report how product mix and urgent delivery change the result.
tests.guard: Do not impose a generic inflation series or assume retail availability at a government delivery date. No regression on eight incomparable records.

tests.name: Independent competition challenge
inputs: bidder identity as of bid date
tests.test: Reconstruct submitted prices, technical acceptability, timestamps and spread. Review common errors, author metadata, bid rotation, withdrawals and losing-bidder subcontracts against neutral templates, shared upstream supply, specialization and capacity.
tests.output: documented pattern with alternatives and missing fields
tests.guard: An offers-received number, distinct legal names or different unit prices does not establish independence. A shared manufacturer does not establish collusion.

tests.name: Buyer decision event study
tests.test: Separate requisitioner, buyer, contracting officer, evaluator, inspector and disbursing official. Compare same-item/same-terms outcomes before and after role changes and against other offices where technically comparable. Report vendor win share, exclusion rationale, amendment timing and split/urgent buys with eligible denominators.
tests.output: a decision pattern requiring explanation, not causation
tests.guard: An award signatory is not assumed to have selected the item, supplier or price. Staffing/capacity/mission changes are confounders.

tests.name: Benefit and influence nexus
inputs: lawfully available actual communications or authoritative findings
tests.test: Build a dated decision-to-benefit timeline only from supporting records; distinguish lawful employment/ownership and ordinary commercial payments from a documented improper exchange. Require more than temporal coincidence or a common surname.
tests.guard: No private financial, residential or family-data collection. No guessed benefit amount, personal profiling or allegation generated from a price residual.

tests.name: Alternative and sensitivity review
inputs: supplier response if already in public record
tests.test: Try to invalidate the apparent premium using pack rounding, full-order cost, compliant certifications, delivery capacity, freight, returns, credit terms, warranty, quantity discounts and timestamp alignment; document why each survives or fails.
tests.output: accept / narrow / reject / unresolved independently signed

tests.name: Amount and loss distinction
tests.test: Report ordered comparison only from order documents. Upgrade to invoiced or paid comparison only with the corresponding records and adjustments. Separate benchmark-relative difference from an official recoverable loss finding.
tests.output: basis-labeled amount with nulls for unsupported loss/payment/benefit
